hypothesis: Fuse the local shifted-logit, target extraction, exponentiation, and denominator accumulation into one persistent per-row kernel while preserving the caller's MAX and two SUM collectives.
scope: local_prepare_fp16_stream only; no Megatron, backward, partition, or collective changes
correctness: Shift every local logit and the local target contribution by global_max; target_mask and target_local are row-shaped.
compatibility: CUDA 11.8, V100 sm_70; finite float initializer avoids CUDART_INF_F.
expected_effect: Reduce local temporary/kernel launch overhead; network and collective behavior remain unchanged.
